content.title: 2026 RBC Heritage payout: Prize money breakdown and full earnings table - NBC Sports
content.text: Matt Fitzpatrick beat Scottie Scheffler by making a birdie on the first playoff hole to win the RBC Heritage and the $3.6 milliion winner’s share from the $20 millino purse.It’s the second RBC Heritage win for Fitzpatrick, who fell into a tie with Scheffler by bogeying the 18th hole of the fourth round at Harbor Town Golf Links in Hilton Head, South Carolina.Scheffler won $2,160,000 for second place, and S.W.
